Now I need to write this in t. I'll need to count prime factors with multiplicity using a loop, then subtract 1.

```t
t 1
gate loops
task count_Fac(n: int) returns (r: int)
  requires n >= 2
  ensures r == count_Fac_spec(n) - 1
spec fun count_Fac_spec(n: int): int
  decreases n
= if n <= 1 then 0 else if n == 2 then 1 else if n % 2 == 0 then 1 + count_Fac_spec(n / 2) else count_Fac_spec(n)
{
  r := 0;
  var i: int := 2;
  var m: int := n;
  while m > 1
    invariant m >= 1
    invariant r >= 0
    decreases m
  {
    if m % i == 0 {
      r := r + 1;
      m := m / i;
    } else {
      i := i + 1;
    }
  }
  r := r - 1;
}
```
